hooks.command:
INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; STMTS=$(printf '%s
' "$CMD" | awk '{ if (sub(/\[ 	]*$/, " ")) { b = b $0; next } print b $0; b = "" } END { if (b != "") print b }' | tr ';&|' '
' | sed -E 's/#.*$//'); HIT=$(printf '%s
' "$STMTS" | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(sudo[[:space:]]+)?rm[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+)*(-[a-zA-Z]*[rR]|--recursive)' | grep -vE '(^|[[:space:]/])(node_modules|dist|build|__pycache__|tmp)(/|[[:space:]]|$)'); if [ -n "$HIT" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: recursive rm on non-safe target. Use specific paths.' >&2; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; CHECK=$(printf '%s\n' "$CMD" | awk '{ if (sub(/\\[ \t]*$/, " ")) { b = b $0; next } print b $0; b = "" } END { if (b != "") print b }' | sed -E 's/--force-with-lease(=[^[:space:]]*)?//g'); if printf '%s\n' "$CHECK" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+.*--force|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard|git[[:space:]]+clean[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*[fd]'; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive git operation. Confirm before proceeding.' >&2; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; CHECK=$(printf '%s\n' "$CMD" | awk '{ if (sub(/\\[ \t]*$/, " ")) { b = b $0; next } print b $0; b = "" } END { if (b != "") print b }'); if printf '%s\n' "$CHECK" | grep -qiE '(api[._-]?key|secret|password|token).*=.*[A-Za-z0-9]{20}'; then echo 'BLOCKED: potential credential in command. Use environment variables.' >&2; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; BASE=$(basename "$FILE"); if echo "$BASE" | grep -qE '^\.env\.(example|sample|template)$'; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$BASE" | grep -qE '^\.env(\..+)?$|\.(pem|key|p12|pfx|credentials|secret)$|^(credentials|secrets?|id_rsa|id_ed25519|\.netrc|\.npmrc)$'; then echo 'BLOCKED: writing to sensitive file. Check if this is intentional.' >&2; exit 2; fi
